title: Anurati Srivastva on Games and Game Design with Divya
summary: Divya talks with game designer Anurati Srivastva, founder of Pedal Studio, about designing learning games for children — why it's so hard to make something both fun and educational, how Indian literary and visual traditions like Madhubani can become interactive mechanics, and what makes kids the harshest, most honest users. They riff on favorite narrative games (Venba, Florence) and how she moved from UNESCO's Games for Learning team into her own practice.

intents.display: to hear a game designer talk about making learning fun for kids
